title: Magbila
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In the Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot ch. 3, halakha 1, Hyman quotes: "Magbila, the brother of Rabbi Abba bar Kohen, said before Rabbi Yosi in the name of Rabbi Aha; Rabbi Aha heard and said: 'I did not say anything to him; bring him, and I will flog him.'" The consulted edition of Berakhot reads the name as “[Gedilah].”
And in Nazir ch. 7, halakha 1, the reading is "gevila".

notes.text: Magbila is identified as Abba bar Kohen’s brother. Acha denies having given him the statement and threatens to flog him. The Nazir reading is Gevila.
